newsitem.title: FRANCE: Gle des Eaux plans 34 pct of SFP - source.
newsitem.headline: Gle des Eaux plans 34 pct of SFP - source.

text.p: French utilities company Cie Generale des Eaux would take up to 34 percent of the SFP film production company if a bid by French businessman Walter Butler for SFP were accepted by the government, a source close to the deal told Reuters on Friday.

Generale des Eaux's support for Butler's bid for the Societe Francaise de Production is conditional on SFP's union reaction to his offer, the source said. The utilities group was "very cautious" on the project.
Butler now planned to cut 430 jobs, instead of 667 initially scheduled, following a rival bid by Belgian firm LBO Convoy.
A Generale des Eaux spokesman declined comment.
Butler's restructuring plan would call for a state recapitalisation of one billion francs, with 463.8 million going to redundancy costs, the source said.

The European Commission on Wednesday ruled illegal state aid of 1.1 billion francs paid to SFP between 1993 and 1996 but Commission officials said it would not make that decision public before October 10, to give the French government time to conclude the privatisation.
